chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: The plan would be to have an updated draft by Monday

chat.author: Jan Romann
chat.text: Good point, it would be a good opportunity to publish an initial version of the CoAP protocol mapping draft by Monday as well :)

chat.text: I went through the newest digital-twin draft and the protocol mapping is needed

chat.author: Peder Bergan
chat.text:
I'm planning the implementation of the SDF non-affordance extentionsion. Issues defined here: 
https://github.com/pederbe/esdieff/issues

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text:
When processing sdfRef, if the target definition contains also sdfRef
   (i.e., is based on yet another definition), that MUST be processed as
   well.

chat.author: Jan Romann
chat.text: I'm afraid I already have to leave – thank you for the presentations and looking forward to the next meeting and further discussions :)

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: (i.e., leave breadcrumbs of where the resolved information came from -- but that probably should not be an sdfRef)

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Let's see whether we have text that says so already

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: The language lawyer says that we didn't change the meaning of these qualities.  And I think we shouldn't.  We can define additional qualities for bytesize
